body_html:
The Craft Round 20" Unit is a fully upholstered modular pouf that turns open floor space into an inviting place to gather. Part of the Craft lounge series, its clean round form pairs with the line's other seats and tables to build casual meeting and breakout layouts that reconfigure as fast as your space changes. Soft 2.5" foam over a sturdy upholstered frame makes it equally at home as a casual perch, a footrest, or flexible lounge seating.

Features

  • Non-handed modular component that reconfigures freely with the rest of the Craft series
  • Round geometric form mixes with Craft seats and tables for infinite collaborative layouts
  • Fully upholstered with a comfortable 2.5" foam cushion
  • Standard 1.5" tall nylon glides; optional dual-wheel carpet (C107) or hard-floor (C107R) casters
  • Available in all grade 1 seating textiles, Luxhide, and graded-in or GPM textiles
  • Rated to 300 lbs and made in Canada

Specifications

Measures 20"W x 20"D x 17.5"H with a 17.5" seat height and weighs 17 lbs. GREENGUARD, GREENGUARD Gold, and ANSI/BIFMA certified, and backed by a 2-year limited warranty on upholstery, foam and moving parts.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964, 296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for textile selection and volume pricing, or call 1-800-835-9565.
